name: 11364 · Oakland Gdns, NY
findings: ZIP 11364 (Oakland Gdns) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11364 (Oakland Gdns) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
93% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11364 (Oakland Gdns) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
